blocks.text: All the bright colours of Brazil in one journey: Rio de Janeiro, as colourful as its carnival; all the colours of the rainbow in the spray of the mighty Iguazu Falls; the mix of styles and eras of Salvador; the canals of Recife, the “Brazilian Venice”, and historic Olinda; and the white sand and turquoise sea of Porto de Galinhas. Welcome to Colorful Brazil!
